description:
FILED s463au (agent AU, round 20) as the measured residue of #960 half (b).
PRE-EXISTING, and NOT an element/boxed-aggregate question â it fails on a
PLAIN SCALAR too, which is what makes it a separate task rather than more of
#960.  Probed 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl on the s463au tree, AFTER #960(b) shipped:

    my $s="hello";  substr($s,0,2) .= "Q";   perl heQllo   PCL hello
    my @a=("hello");substr($a[0],0,2).="Q";  perl heQllo   PCL hello
    my $t="12345";  substr($t,0,2) += 7;     perl 19345    PCL 12345
    my @b=("12345");substr($b[0],0,2)+=7;    perl 19345    PCL 12345
    my $v="\0\0";   vec($v,0,8) |= 65;       perl 65       PCL 0
    my @d=("\0\0"); vec($d[0],0,8) |= 65;    perl 65       PCL 0
  (controls, all agreeing after #960(b))
    my $u="hello";  substr($u,0,2) =~ tr/a-z/A-Z/;  BOTH HEllo
    my @c=("hello");substr($c[0],0,2)=~tr/a-z/A-Z/; BOTH HEllo

Every one is a SILENT WRONG: the compound assignment computes the right new
value and drops it.

MECHANISM.  A magic-lvalue window has THREE write spellings and PCL now serves
all three (task #960 half (b) / #939): `= V`, the 4-argument call, and the
`=~` target.  A COMPOUND assignment is a fourth, and it goes through
`%define-compound-pair`'s `%store-back-form`, which does not recognise
`(p-substr â¦)` / `(p-vec â¦)` / `(p-pos â¦)` as places at all â `p-setf` has an
arm per magic-lvalue head (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~6620: p-pos, p-vec ->
p-vec-set, p-substr -> the 4-arg form) and %store-back-form has none, so the
computed value is written to nothing.

FIX SHAPE, and it is a rule-11 one: %store-back-form should route a
magic-lvalue place through the SAME arms p-setf already has, rather than grow
its own copy â the natural spelling is `(p-setf PLACE <new value>)` for
exactly those heads, with the current-value form read from the place first
(both are the `cur` the macro already builds).  The EMITTER half is already
done: Pl::ExprToCL::_lvalue_target_form gives substr/vec/pos their target
argument in perl's loose lvalue context for the other three spellings, and the
compound path needs the same call (its `$op` is `.=`/`+=`/`|=`/â¦ rather than
`=`).

BAR: the eight rows above; `$s .= "x"` and `$a[0] .= "x"` (ordinary compound
assignment) unmoved; the #939/#960 guard rows in Pl/t/lvalue-ref-01.t
unmoved; corpus-diff + emission A/B over the four populations for the emitter
half; full sweep for the runtime half.
subject: SILENT WRONG: a COMPOUND assignment through a magic-lvalue window (substr(...) .= / += , vec(...) |=) computes the value and writes it nowhere -- on a plain scalar too
